profile.name: Julian
profile.description: Developer, dragon, structure nerd and Minecraft infrastructure architect.

values.title: Accessibility
values.text: I want people to be able to use what I build, including with a keyboard or assistive tools.

values.title: Understandable interfaces
values.text: It should be clear what a button does and what happens next.

values.title: Self-hosting & privacy
values.text: I like running my own services and keeping control over personal data.

values.title: Automation
values.text: I write tools for tasks I would otherwise have to keep doing by hand.

values.title: Maintainability
values.text: I care about structure that I can still understand when I return to a project.

values.title: Open standards
values.text: I prefer formats and interfaces that can work with other tools.

infrastructure.text: I run self-hosted services using Linux, Docker and nginx. Some live on my own server; smaller hardware projects use a Raspberry Pi.

building.title: This website
building.text: Bringing my old pages and project notes into this new little corner.

updates.title: A new home for the website
updates.text: The SeaWing’s Den / JulianOS version now brings together my old pages, art gallery, collection and project list.
